simple.meaning: אֵל (ʼêl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “near , with or among ; often in general, to.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5516 times across Genesis, beginning at Genesis 1:9. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵל (H413).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֵל (ʼêl) / H413 is traced through Genesis 1:9, Genesis 2:19, Genesis 2:22, Genesis 3:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H413. el אֶל (nearly always followed by Makkeph), in poetry אֱלֵי (compare עֲדֵי עֲלֵי, ), but only in Job ( 1 Samuel 3:22; 1 Samuel 5:26; 1Sam 15:22 ; 1 Samuel 29:19), with suffix אֵלַיִךְ אֵלֶיךָ, אֵלַי, , etc. אֲלֵיכֶם אֵלֵינוּ, & (5 t.) אֲלֵיהֶם אֲלֵכֶם, & אֲלֵהֶם (both very often); once אֵלֵימוֺ Psa 2:5 , אֲלֵיהֶן , once אֲלֵהֶן Exod 1:19 (Assyrian ilî , Arabic ), preposition denoting motion to or direction towards (whether physical or mental). 1 of motion to or unto a person or place Gen 2:19 , 22 ; 3:19 ; 8:9 ; 14:22 ; 16:9 etc., after every kind of verb expressing motion ( יָצָא הָלַךְ, בּוֺא, etc.) So with נָתַן to give (though ל is here more common) 21:14 ; 35:4 ; Deut 13:2 +; מָכַר to sell Deut 37:36, etc. Metaph. Jer 2:19 אֵלַיִךְ פַחְדָּתִי וְלֹא and that my fear (cometh) not unto thee (compare Job 31:23 ). — Peculiarly Gen 6:16 אַמָּה אֶל unto the length of a cubit, etc. And metaphor in the phrase אֶלֿ(אֱלֵיֿ)גִּיל unto exultation Hosea 9:11 ; Job 3:22 . Once, exceptionally (si vera 1.) = even: 5:5 יִקָּחֵהוּ וְאֶלמִֿצִּגִּים and even out of thorns he taketh it. Sometimes pregnant, as Isa 66:17 ; Jer 41:7 אֶל זָנָה commit whoredom (by going) to Num 25:1 ; Ezek 16:26 , 28 , 29 ; אֶל דָּרֵשׁ seek (by resorting) to one (that is, for oracles) Deut 18:11 ; Isa 8:19 ; 11:10 +; אֶל חָבַר join together (& come) unto Gen 14:3 ; אֶל הִשְׁכִּים rise early (and go) to 19:27 ; 24:11 אֶל הִבְרִיח made to kneel down at ; 47:18 אֶל תַּם i.e. has been made over to ; אֶל מָּחַד to come in fear to Hosea 3:5 ; Micah 7:17 . Opposite is מִן , as אֶלהַֿקָּצֶה מִןהַֿקָּצֶה from end to end Exod 26:28 ; אֶלמֶּֿה מִמֶּה Ezra 9:11 (synonym 2Kin 21:16 לָפֶה מֶּה ). And of time (rare) אֶלעֵֿת מֵעֵת 1Chr 9:25 ; אֶליֿוֺם מִיּוֺם Num 30:15 (P) 1Chr 16:23 (in the || Psa 96:2 לְיוֺם מִיּוֺם ). 2 Where the limit is actually entered, into , Gen 6:18 and thou shalt enter into the ark 7:1 ; 19:3 ; 41:21 ; 42:17 ; & so after verbs of throwing, casting, putting 37:22 ( הִשְׁלִיךְ ) 39:20 הַסֹּהַר אֶלבֵּֿית וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ put him into the prison house, Exod 28:30 ( Lev 8:8 ) Deut 23:25 ; so after קָבַר to bury Gen 23:19 ; 25:9 ; 49:29 ; שָׂחַט to squeeze 40:11 ; מָחָה to blot out Num 5:23 , etc.; metaphor Gen 6:6 was pained into or unto his heart, הֵשִׁיב אֶללֵֿב, שָׂם to place, bring. into ( = lay to ) heart Deut 4:39 ; 2Sam 19:20 and elsewhere In connection with a number or multitude into which something enters, in among: 1Sam 10:22 behold he had hid himself אֶלהַֿכֵּלִים in among the baggage, Jer 4:3 sow not אֶלקֹֿצִים in among thorns. 3 Of direction towards anything: ( a ) of physical acts or states, as Gen 30:40 אֶל הַצּאֹן מְּנֵי נָתַן , 39:7 אֶל עֵינָיו נָשָׂא , Exod 25:20 ; Num 6:26 , אֶל פָנָיו נָשָׂא ( 2Kin 9:32 differently), 24:1 אֶל מָּנָיו שָׁת , Josh 8:18 ; Psa 28:2 ; 1Kin 8:29-30 , (to pray towards ) 8:38 ; pregnantly אֶל חָרֵד to tremble (turning) to Gen 42:28 , אֶל תָּמַהּ to, wonder (turning) towards 43:33 ; Isa 13:8 , אֶל מָּחַד Jer 36:16 : without a verb אֶלמָּֿנִים מָּנִים face to face Gen 32:31 +; אֶלמֶּֿה מֶּה Num 12:8 ; אֵלַי כִּיאֵֿינֶנּוּ Gen 31:5 the face of Laban, that he is not toward me; י ׳עֵינֵי ׳אֶלפֿ the eyes of ׳י are towards . . . ( c ) with words expressing the direction of the mind, as קִוָּה to wait Psa 27:14 +; יִחַל to hope Isa 51:5 ; אֶל נֶפֶשׁ נָשָׂא to lift up the soul (i.e. set the desire) towards Deut 24:15 ; Psa 25:1 ; שָׁת אֶל, לֵב שָׂם to set the heart (mind) to Exod 9:21 and elsewhere; אֶל לָמַד to accustom oneself to Jer 10:2 ; אֶל חָרֵד to shew fear towards 2Kin 4:13 ; Gen 43:30 ; Deut 28:32 and thy eyes אֲלֵיהֶם כָּלוֺת failing (with longing) towards them, Lam 4:17 ; Isa 63:15 ; 2Sam 3:8 ; 1Kin 14:13 ; Psa 40:6 ; alone, as predicate, directed or disposed towards , Gen 3:16 ; 4:7 ; 2Kin 6:11 who of ours is towards (i.e. favours) the king of Syria? Hosea 3:3 אֵלָֽיִח׃ וְגַםאֲֿנִי Ezek 36:9 ; Hag 2:17 ; Jer 15:1 ( אֶל נַפְשִׁי אֵין ). 4 Where the motion or direction implied appears from the context to be of a hostile character, אֶל = against: Gen 4:8 ק ׳וַיָּקָם אֶלהֶֿבֶל and Cain rose up against Abel (so 1Sam 24:8 ) 22:12 ; Exod 14:5 ; Num 32:14 ; with נִקְבַּץ Josh 10:6 , הָלַךְ Judg 1:10 ; 20:30 ; with בָּא of calamity, etc., coming to or upon any one Gen 42:21 ; Judg 9:57 ; 1Sam 2:34 ; 1Kin 14:10 +; Isa 2:4 ; 3:8 their tongue and doings are ׳אֶליֿ 32:6 ( אֶל לְדַבֵּר ) Hosea 7:15 (compare Nahum 1:9 ) Hosea 12:5 אֶלמַֿלְאָךְ וַיָּשַׂר and he strove against the angel. Here also belongs in particular the phrase ֗֗֗ אֶל הִנְנִי Behold I am against (thee, you, etc.) Nahum 2:14; Nahum 3:5 ; Jer 21:13 ( 23:30-32 על ) 50:31 ; 51:25 ; Ezek 13:8 , 20 ; 21:8 ; 29:10 ; 30:22 ; 34:10 ; 35:3 ; 38:3 ; 39:1 ( 5:8 ; 26:3 ; 28:22 ; 29:3 על : on 36:9 see above) 5 Unto sometimes acquires from the context the sense of in addition to , as Lev 18:18 thou shalt not take אֲחוֺתָהּ אֶל אִשָּׁה a woman to, in addition to , her sister, Josh 13:22 (|| Num 31:8 על ); 1Sam 14:34 at eat אֶלהַֿחָם together with the blood ( 14:32 & Generally עַל ); 1Kin 10:7 אֶל הוֺסִיף (generally עַל ); Jer 25:26 ; Ezek 7:26 שְׁמוּעָה אֶל שְׁמוּעָה || (עלׅ ; 44:7 ; Lam 3:41 let us lift up אֶלכַּֿמָּ֑יִם לְבָבֵנוּ our hearts together with the hands (compare , Qor 4:2; W AG ii. § 51 c ). 6 Metaphor in regard to, concerning, on account of : thus הִתְאַבֵּל to mourn concerning 1Sam 15:35 ; הִנָּחֵם to repent as regards 2Sam 24:16 ; דָּרַשׁ to inquire 1Kin 14:5 הִתְמַּלֵּל to pray with regard to 1Sam 1:27 ; 2Kin 19:20 ; צָעַק to cry 8:3 ( 8:5 על ); נֶעֳצַב be pained 1Sam 20:34 ; נִחַם to comfort 2Sam 10:2 ; more Generally 1Kin 16:13 ; 21:22 ; אֶלנֶֿפֶשׁ on account of, for the sake of , one's life 19:3 ; 2Kin 7:7 ( Gen 19:17 על ). ( עַל is more common in this sense.) And specially with verbs of saying, narrating, telling, etc. with regard to , as אָמַר 20:2 ; Isa 29:22 ; 37:21 , 33 +; דִּבֶּר 2Sam 7:19 ; Jer 40:16 b; סִמֵּר Psa 2:7 ; 69:27 ; צִוָּה Isa 23:11 ; שָׁמַע Ezek 19:4 ; אֶל הַשְּׁמוּעָה the report regarding . . . 1Sam 4:19 . (Not frequently, ext. in the case of אָמַר .) 7 Of rule or standard, according to (rare): ֗֗֗ אֶלמִּֿי according to the command of, Josh 15:13 ; 17:4 ; 21:3 (generally עַלמִּֿי ); אֶלנָֿבוֺן according to what is fixed = of a certainty 1Sam 23:23 ; 26:4 (see Dr): perhaps Psa 5:1 ; 80:1 ( 45:1 עַל ). 8 Expressing presence at a spot, against; at, by , not merely after verbs expressing or implying motion (compare 1 , Gen 24:11 ), as Josh 11:5 and they came and encamped together מֵרוֺם אֶלמֵֿי at the waters of Merom, 1Sam 5:4 cut off (and fallen) on to the threshold, 2Sam 2:23 and elsewhere and smote him אֶלהַֿחֹמֶשׁ in or on the belly, Deut 33:28 ; Exod 29:12 ; Lev 4:7 ; but also in other cases, as Josh 5:3 and he circumcised the Israelites אֶל against, at the hill of the foreskins, 22:11 have built an altar הַיַּרְדֵּן גְּלִילוֺת אֶל by the districts of Jordan, Judg 12:6 ; 2Sam 3:32 , 14:30 & 18:4 אֶליַֿד at the side of (elsewhere יַד עַל לְיַד, ), 1Kin 13:20 as they were sitting אֶלהַֿשֻּׁלְחָן at the table, 2Kin 11:14 אֶלהַֿמֶּלֶךְ by the king, Jer 41:12 and found him by the great waters, etc., 46:10 מְּרָת אֶלנְֿהַר by the Euphrates, Ezek 3:15 ; 11:11 ; 17:8 ; 31:7 ; 40:18 ; 43:3 ; 47:7 ; 48:12 . 9 Prefixed to other preps. it combines with them the idea of motion or direction to: thus אֶלאַֿחֲרֵי 2Sam 5:23 ; 2Kin 9:18-19 , אֶלאַֿחֲרַי סֹב turn to behind me, Zech 6:5 (where אֶל is pleonastic, probably due to clerical error; note אל יצא before & after); אֶלבֵּֿין in between Ezek 31:10 , 14 ; אֵלבֵּֿינוֺת similarly 10:2 ; לְ ׳אֶלמִֿבֵּית to (the part) within (see below בַּיִת ), in within Lev 16:15 ; 2Kin 11:15 || have her forth in within the ranks; אֶלמֿוּל see מוּל ; לְ ׳אֶלמִֿנֶּגֶב unto the south of Josh 15:3 ; לְ ׳אֶלמִֿחוּץ to the outside of Lev 4:12 , 21 +; אֶלנֹֿכַח to the front of Num 19:4 ; אֶלתַּֿחַת Judg 6:19 ; 1Kin 8:6 and elsewhere (see below תַּחַת ). Note I. — In Gen 20:13 וג אִמְרִילִֿי ׳שָׁמָּה נָבוֺא אֲשֶׁר אֶלכָּֿלהַֿמָּקוֺם ; Num 33:54 וג ׳אֶלאֲֿשֶׁר ; Prov 17:8 (compare Deut 16:6 ); — אֶל appears to be used by a species of attraction; the idea of motion involved in the relative clause influencing illogically the beginning of the sentence and causing אֶל to be used instead of בְּ . In 31:14 אֵלֵיהֶם , as pointed, can only be from אַיִל III or IV (q. v.); if the word be taken as the Pronoun with suffix (Hi Ke), אֲלֵיהֶם must be read. Note 2. — There is a tendency in Hebrew, especially manifest in Samuel Kings Jeremiah Ezekiel, to use אֶל in the sense of עַל ; sometimes אֶל being used exceptionally in a phrase or construction which regularly, and in accusative with analogy, has עַל ; sometimes, the two prepositions interchanging, apparently without discrimination, in the same or parallel sentences. Thus ( a ) Josh 5:14 אֶלמָּֿנָיו וִיִּמֹּל ; 1Sam 13:13 י ׳הֵקִים אֶליִֿשְׂרָאֵל אֶתמַֿמְלַכְתְּךָ ; 14:34 (see below 5 ); 17:3 אֶלהָֿהָר עֹמְדִים (contractee עַל Deut 11:29 ); 19:16 ; 2Sam 6:3 ; 20:23 (contracted 8:16 ) 1Kin 13:29 ; 18:46 (contracted 2Kin 3:15 על ) Jer 35:15 ; Ezek 7:18 . ( b ) Judg 6:37 and upon ( עַל ) all the earth let there be dryness, 6:39 let there be dryness on ( אֶל ) the fleece; 1Sam 14:10 come up עָלֵינוּ , 14:12 come up אֵלֵינוּ ; 16:23 & 16; 16:13 & 18:10 אֶל צָלַח , 10:6 and elsewhere עַל צָלַח ; 25:17 evil is determined כָּלבֵּֿיתוֺ וְעַל אֶלאֲֿדֹנֵינוּ ; 25:25 ; 27:10 ; 2Sam 2:9 וְ֗֗֗עַל וְ֗֗֗עַל וְ֗֗֗עַל וְ֗֗֗אֶל וְ֗֗֗אֶל אֶל וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ ; 3:29 ֗֗֗ וְאֶל ֗֗֗ עַל יָחֻלוּ 2Kin 8:3 & 5; 9:6 & 3; Jer 19:15 ; 25:2 ; 26:15 ye lay innocent blood הַזּאֹת וְאֶלהָֿעִיר עֲלֵיכֶם ; 27:19 ; 28:8 ; 33:14 ; 34:7 ; 36:31 ; 37:13-14 , Ezek 18:6 , 11 & 15; 21:12 etc. Psa 79:6 ( Jer 10:25 על twice). It is probably that this interchange, at least in many cases, is not original, but due to transcribers. Conversely, though not with the same frequency, עַל occurs where analogy would lead us to expect אֶל , or even in juxtaposition with אֶל , as 1Sam 1:10 עַל הִתְמַּלֵּל to pray to ( 1:26 אֶל ); 1:13 ; 25:25 אֶלעַ֗֗֗ל ; 1Kin 20:43 עַלבֵּֿיתוֺ וַיֵּלֶךְ ( 21:4 אֶל ); Isa 22:15 ; Jer 11:2 ; 23:35 ; 31:12 . compare Dr Sm i. 13, 13 ; ii. 8, 7; 15, 4.
